statement.text:
A brace (G; +, ◦) is non-empty set G with two binary operations +, ◦ such
that (G, +) is an additively written abelian group, (G, ◦) is a multiplicatively written
group, and a ◦ (b + c) + a = (a ◦ b) + (a ◦ c) for all a, b, c ∈ G. Does there exist a brace
with finitely generated group (G, +) such that
   a) the group (G, ◦) is non-solvable?
   b) the group (G, ◦) contains a non-abelian free group?
                                       V. G. Bardakov, M. V. Neshchadim, M. K. Yadav

                                New Problems
